extraction.document_summary:
Singlife Shield is an Integrated Shield Plan that provides enhanced hospitalisation coverage beyond MediShield Life for both public and private hospital treatment, with coverage options by ward type. The brochure states three base plans: Shield Plan 1 (A) covers “Private Hospital (any standard ward)” with a policy-year limit “Up to S$2 million”; Shield Plan 2 (A) covers “Public Hospital (any standard ward (A))” with limit “Up to S$1.2 million”; Shield Plan 3 (B) covers “Public Hospital (any 4-bed standard ward (B1))” with limit “Up to S$500,000”. It also describes pre-hospitalisation as-charged coverage up to 180 days and post-hospitalisation up to 365 days.

Singlife Health Plus is described as an add-on rider that reduces out-of-pocket costs and adds additional benefits. Under a private-hospital example, co-insurance can reduce from 10% (capped at S$25,500/year) to 5% (capped at S$6,000/year). Health Plus also includes outpatient cancer drug coverage on the CDL (stated as “Outpatient Cancer Drug Treatment on the CDL”) and adds other rider benefits such as Mental Wellness Benefit (after 10 months’ continuous cover) and the Singlife Care Collab Recovery Support Benefit (up to S$20,000 per lifetime, max 730 consecutive days). A key limitation noted is that “Class F treatments are not covered” under non-CDL outpatient cancer drug treatment.
quality_notes: The Markdown contains broken/garbled text in several places (e.g., headings and some lines around the plan tables).
Some fields (e.g., entry ages, exact co-insurance/deductible linkage for each plan, and underwriting/renewability) are not stated explicitly.
Despite garbling, the document clearly states major mechanics and multiple benefit limits/conditions, and provides explicit exclusions (Class F not covered).

policies.quick_summary: An Integrated Shield Plan providing enhanced hospitalisation coverage (A&E/preferred providers, pre- and post-hospital treatment) beyond MediShield Life, with base plan limits by ward/hospital type. The add-on rider Singlife Health Plus is used to reduce co-insurance (e.g., 10% capped vs 5% capped) and provides added outpatient cancer and other support benefits (e.g., Mental Wellness Benefit after 10 months; Recovery Support up to S$20,000/lifetime). Class F non-CDL outpatient cancer treatments are not covered under the non-CDL framework note in the brochure’s important notes section when referencing non-CDL classification.
coverage_scope: Enhanced hospitalisation coverage for public and private hospital treatments
A&E or preferred medical provider coverage mechanics
Pre-hospitalisation treatment up to 180 days before hospitalisation
Post-hospitalisation treatment up to 365 days after discharge
Outpatient cancer drug treatment (CDL and non-CDL) (as described in benefits table/notes)
Extra inpatient benefit for 5 critical illnesses (labeled in the plan benefits table)
Outpatient psychiatric consultation (Mental Wellness Benefit) (conditions/limits described in important notes)
important_caveats: This policy has no savings or investment feature; the brochure states there is no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely.
Outpatient cancer drug treatments under the non-CDL framework: “Class F treatments are not covered.”
Mental Wellness Benefit requires the policy be in force continuously for at least 10 months from the cover start date.

review_notes: This policy object models the base as Singlife Shield (Integrated Shield Plan). The add-on Singlife Health Plus is represented as a rider under riders and has rider-tier plan objects for Private and Public only where explicitly named.
Entry age, renewal terms, free-look/grace periods, and detailed underwriting are not stated in the provided brochure extract.

Some rider benefit categorisation (e.g., whether Outpatient cancer non-CDL is rider-covered) is inferred only insofar as the brochure labels items under the combined Shield/Health Plus benefit list; the Class F exclusion is explicit and captured.
